correction: V5 restores donor MainActor validation and registers the actual Hanlin+Sharing publication task before suspension. Stop captures its exact previous-attempt record, retires that parent and joins only this publication task before the first owner closes.
finding: Stage checks before and after an awaited actor hop do not prevent the owner's synchronous open from executing after parent retirement. The v4 composition dropped the donor's same-turn MainActor validation. Sharing.didOpen has no supplied attempt validation, so an admitted queued open could occur after Stop's first close; a final reclose restores only terminal state.
